genesis.6.p1.b1.text: Now when men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them,

genesis.6.p1.b2.text: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days … they bore them children who became the mighty men of old, men of renown.

genesis.6.p1.b3.text: I will blot out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth—every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air—for I am grieved that I have made them.

genesis.6.p1.b4.text: And the LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.

genesis.6.p1.b5.text: Noah, however, found favor in the eyes of the LORD.

genesis.6.p2.b6.text: Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.

genesis.6.p2.b7.text: And Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

genesis.6.p2.b8.text: Now the earth was corrupt in the sight of God, and full of violence.

genesis.6.p2.b9.text: all living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways.

genesis.6.p3.b10.text: The end of all living creatures has come before Me, because through them the earth is full of violence. Now behold, I will destroy both them and the earth.

genesis.6.p3.b11.text: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; … The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.

genesis.6.p3.b12.text: And behold, I will bring floodwaters upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens … Everything on the earth will perish.

genesis.6.p4.b13.text: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.

genesis.6.p5.b14.text: The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.

genesis.6.p5.b15.text: place a door in the side of the ark, and build lower, middle, and upper decks.

genesis.6.p6.b16.text: But I will establish My covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

genesis.6.p6.b17.text: You are also to take for yourself every kind of food that is eaten and gather it as food for yourselves and for the animals.”

genesis.6.p6.b18.text: So Noah did everything precisely as God had commanded him.
